sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        out[n['id']]=(n['color'],n['pixels'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return out
def real_change(b,a):
    ch=[k for k in set(b)|set(a) if b.get(k)!=a.get(k) and k not in (0,1)]
    return ch
cands={'bar1(45,14)':(45,14),'bar2(55,26)':(55,26),'bar3(45,36)':(45,36),
       'bar4(40,48)':(40,48),'flagG(41,14)':(41,14),'trackW(55,10)':(55,10),
       'trackB(56,12)':(56,12),'flagY(29,53)':(29,53)}
for name,(r,c) in cands.items():
    b=snap(current_frame)
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}], intent='explore')
    a=snap(current_frame)
    ch=real_change(b,a)
    print(name,'-> real_change:',ch)
    if ch:
        print('   detail:', {k:(b.get(k),a.get(k)) for k in ch})
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
